title: German Army to Start Training With New Attack Drones Next Month
why_it_matters_hint: Headline only: German Army soldiers are due to start training with new attack drones next month.
event_date: unknown (training due to start in Nov 2026)
notes: Bloomberg returned HTTP 403 (bot wall). Google News searches found no other outlet carrying this specific story (which drones, how many, supplier all unknown). Related but different coverage: Pistorius announced a first German Army drone regiment for 2027 on 1 Oct 2026 (hartpunkt via Calibre Defence, Mezha), with Army inspector Freuding saying unmanned systems would start reaching infantry, reconnaissance and armoured forces by year-end; it is not stated that this is the same programme, so nothing from it is used in the entry.
